blocks.text: Visayan Electric brought free legal assistance to residents of Barangay Talamban, Cebu City, through its Legal Aid Program held on November 6, 2026, at the Talamban Gym and Sports Complex. In partnership with volunteer lawyers from the Aboitiz Group and partner law firms, the initiative offered free legal consultations, notarization of simple affidavits, and assistance with Visayan Electric-related concerns to make legal guidance more accessible, particularly to low-income and marginalized communities. The program was facilitated by Visayan Electric in collaboration with the Aboitiz Foundation, and other organizations within the Aboitiz Group s, volunteer lawyers, and Barangay Talamban.
